title: Nordhaus-Gaddum inequalities for the number of 1-nearly independent vertex subsets
summary: For a graph $G$, a vertex subset is called \emph{$1$-nearly independent} if the subgraph it induces contains exactly one edge. Let $σ_1(G)$ denote the number of such subsets in $G$. In this paper, we study Nordhaus-Gaddum type inequalities for $σ_1$, that is, bounds on the sum $σ_1(G)+σ_1(\overline{G})$, where $\overline{G}$ denotes the complement of $G$. We establish that, for any $n$-vertex graph $G$, we have $σ_1(G)+σ_1(\overline{G})\geq n(n-1)/2,$ with equality if and only if $G$ is either complete or edgeless.
